_comment: Recipes that are hardcoded in the game and therefore absent from the vanilla datapack: the crafting_special_* recipes and the whole brewing stand. Hand-maintained. Ingredients written as #tag_name are resolved by tools/build.mjs. Virtual items (potions) are declared in "items" and merged into the generated data.

notes.firework_rocket_simple: 1 to 3 gunpowder sets the flight duration (1, 2 or 3). Add up to 7 firework stars to give the rocket its explosion effects.
notes.map_cloning: Copies a map. Both maps then update together as you explore.
notes.netherite_ingot: Netherite scraps come from smelting ancient debris found below Y=16 in the Nether.

recipes.note: Copy a banner pattern: put the decorated banner next to a blank banner of the same colour. Works with every colour.
Add up to 8 books and quills to make up to 8 copies at once. A copy of a copy cannot be copied again.
Use up to 8 dyes for multi-coloured stars. Shape: fire charge = large ball, gold nugget = star, feather = burst, head = creeper. Effect: glowstone dust = twinkle, diamond = trail.
Adds a fade-to-colour to an existing firework star.
Zooms the map out one level (up to level 4). Can also be done at a cartography table.
Applies a banner pattern to a shield. The banner is consumed.
Any two damaged items of the same type combine into one. Durability is added together plus a 5% bonus. Enchantments are lost - use an anvil to keep them.
Right-click a water source or a filled cauldron with glass bottles. The brewing stand itself is not needed for this step.
